branches.description: Physical movement and the people, routes, vehicles, and belongings associated with going from place to place.
Deliberate deeds become a person's actions and, by extension, their habitual moral bearing.
Taking something forward becomes carrying out plans, duties, authority, policies, and organized affairs.
What moves onward through society may be issued, spread, or become widely prevalent.
A continuing process or system is viewed as moving along in operation.
The ability to go forward yields the sense that something is possible or acceptable.

curriculumMeanings.description: Movement along a course, extended to doing, carrying matters forward, and functioning.

branches.description: A line of work defines an occupation, its peers, and those with or without insider expertise.
A business line becomes a commercial establishment and the conditions of its market activity.
Arrangement in rows develops into placement or membership within an ordered grouping.

curriculumMeanings.description: An arranged row, extended to recognized lines of work, commercial establishments, and relative standing.
